## Validation

Include commands, aggregate test summary and exit status.

## Honesty checklist

- [ ] Missing evidence is NOT MEASURED, never PASS.
- [ ] Every metric names its source, sample size, units and limits.
- [ ] Fixture checks and live measurements are distinguished.
- [ ] Uncertainty, failed controls and judge disagreement remain visible.
- [ ] Dataset licences and attribution permit committed artifacts.
- [ ] No recordings, private transcripts, personal contacts or secrets are included.
